news.title: School psychology students lead at PALS summer camp
news.summary_en: Five students from the IU School of Education’s school psychology program spent part of their summer giving back through a community project, where they helped children build social-emotional skills in a unique camp setting alongside horses.

news.title: High school seniors explore careers in education and college life at summer program
news.summary_en: Over the summer, high school students stayed on the IU Bloomington campus for the Factor Future Educator Program, a one-week summer immersion experience. These students, all about to enter their senior year, were introduced to what IU and the IU School of Education had to offer through mini-workshops, campus tours, and college readiness sessions.
